description: Page 1 of Amazon US search for a keyword, as Logimu last OBSERVED it (head search terms taken from Amazon's own autocomplete, each observed about once a week, all departments, one US delivery ZIP): the organic order with product facts (title, brand, price, rating) and each product's latest observed buy box (seller, AMZ / FBA / FBM, other sellers), the sponsored units present in the page HTML (Sponsored Brands banners and videos, server-rendered Sponsored Products; ones Amazon loads later by JavaScript are counted as slots only), the Overall Pick (Amazon's Choice) holder, Amazon's result count, page_summary (organic slots by brand and by buy-box seller, Amazon's own buy boxes, FBA / FBM, Sponsored Brands units by brand) and the products that entered or left page 1 since the previous observation, all dated. history=true adds every weekly observation and the rank series of the page's products. USE WHEN the user asks which products, brands or sellers hold page 1 for a search term, who advertises on it, or how the page changed. Amazon US only. NOT volume figures (Amazon publishes none for search terms and none is implied) and NOT live: a dated weekly sample, and the same search minutes apart differs by a few products - for a live page use the serp tool, for what Amazon suggests for a seed the keywords tool, for the keywords a product shows up for product_keywords. A keyword outside the observed set is free (keyword_not_found). COST: paid plan required (listed only for keys on a paid plan); 1 credit (+0.5 with history when more than one observation exists). Counts against the derived daily cap (default 2,000 calls per account).

country.description: Amazon US only: the map covers amazon.com search.

history.description: Also return every weekly observation and the products' rank series; +0.5 credit when more than one exists.

keyword.description: A search term, e.g. 'micro sd card 128gb high endurance' (case-insensitive).

name: keyword_rankings
